messages:
alex: Quick doc sync 1: PR #8422 has a mismatch in the /v1/streams example: curl uses `auth_token` header and the response shows `chunk` fields which don't match runtime.

maria: Which runtime format do we expect?

alex: Runtime emits delta objects and a final done event, e.g. { "delta": "text", "done": false } and { "done": true }. Also header should be `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.

jamal: I can patch the OpenAPI to rename `stream` -> `streaming` and add an alias note. Docs should prefer `streaming`.

sam: I'll fix the curl snippet and the Authorization example. Use `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"`.

maria: Update the response example block and add a one-line note about partial vs final events. Keep sample minimal.

alex: Suggested sample: ```json
{ "id": "stream_abc", "events": [ { "delta": "Hello ", "done": false }, { "delta": "world", "done": false }, { "done": true } ] }
```

sam: Pushed curl fix (sha 9f3a2c).

jamal: Pushed OpenAPI param rename + alias note (sha b1c7de).

maria: Pushed response example update (sha 4d9eaa).

alex: @docs-bot can you run preview?
